Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL1158408. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1158408. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID. Do not deduplicate.
